title: Pack of 3 Pellet Boats Head One - Head
description:
The Pack of 3 Head One Ball Jars is ideal for buying high-end balls with a great offer. The Pack of 3 Head One Ball Cans is ideal for those players who are looking for a high-end ball from a reputable brand, with a very good offer.

Remember that at Pádel Ibérico you will receive your Head Pádel One padel balls in 24-48 hours at your home.

This Pack contains 3 cans of 3 Head Pádel One paddle balls.

Head padel balls are sponsored in the professional padel league World Pádel Tour.
